newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Smit Int seals fleet sale to Seacor.
newsitem.headline: Smit Int seals fleet sale to Seacor.

text.p: Shipping group Smit Internationale said on Friday it had finalised the sale of its fleet of offshore supply ships to U.S. firm Seacor Holding Inc and agreed the sale of four more.
The completed transaction pertains to 24 vessels fully-owned by Smit and Smit's stake in 21 vessels operating under joint venture, the Dutch firm said in a statement.
It said it would be paid $71.1 million plus 712,000 Seacor shares valued at $45.6 million and $22 million of convertible bonds.
It will also receive an additional earnings-related payment in cash and bonds of up to $47.2 million, based on the earnings performance of the fleet in 1997 and 1998.
Smit said that alongside this transaction the two parties had agreed the sale of four vessels valued at $12.9 million.
"The parties expect that these ships will be transferred to Seacor or a joint venture in which Seacor is active within several months," Smit said in a statement.
It said that the two had also agreed that Smit would continue to supply the crews for North Sea and Far East vessels, with Seacor changing its name to Seacor-Smit Holdings Inc.
